title: AIR CONDITIONING-FRONT VACUUM HOSES & WSWA RESERVOIR
summary: Air conditioning (C60) engine-compartment vacuum hose routing to the plenum air valve actuator and water valve, plus the relocated windshield washer (WSWA) fluid reservoir (washer jar) at the front corner. The reservoir hangs on a bracket, and a shield sits beside it; both are riveted to the inner panel. The washer hose runs from the filter in the reservoir to the washer pump. The A/C harness fuse holder lead routes along the engine harness to the horn relay battery terminal.

parts.name: HOSE
parts.name_expanded: Hose – windshield washer reservoir to pump

parts.name: RESERVOIR ASM.

fastening.note: View A: rivets [4] go through the holes in the panel to fasten the reservoir bracket [5] and the shield [6]. Hole info in Section 0.
View A: the reservoir [3] hooks over / sits in the U-shaped bracket [5]; no separate fastener shown.
Hose [2] enters the reservoir top and ends in filter [7] at the bottom; the other end runs along the harness to the washer pump.
View B: cut the production yellow-stripe vacuum hose and connect it to the A/C vacuum hose; hoses held by production clamp and grommet at the dash.
